main.description: Looks up one indexed attachment by exact AT-URI and hydrates its publisher actor. The full record is preserved unchanged; subjects, content, and location remain unexpanded, and external files are not fetched. Missing author profile or organization sidecar is null; operational hydration failures return errors. A missing indexed attachment is RecordNotFound. Authentication is not required.

uri.description: Full attachment record AT-URI using a DID authority.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The URI is invalid or is not an attachment record AT-URI.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No indexed attachment exists at this AT-URI.

errors.name: AttachmentQueryFailed
errors.description: The attachment query or required publisher hydration failed; retry after checking the HappyView PostgreSQL service.

attachmentView.description: Attachment record view with hydrated publisher actor and the full indexed record unchanged; subject, content, and location references remain unexpanded.
